question: What is the biggest thing you got away with at a job?
story: I ran an entire department at my company for seven months and I was never actually hired for the job. I was a temp. Front desk, six week contract, answering phones. Then my manager quit on a Friday and nobody told corporate. On Monday people started emailing me questions, so I answered them. Someone added me to the leadership call. I said nothing and took notes. Within a month I was approving schedules, running the Tuesday meeting, and signing off on supply orders. Nobody ever asked. Everybody assumed somebody else had promoted me. Here is the part that still keeps me up. I was good at it. Our numbers went up two quarters in a row. Then payroll finally caught the error and a woman from HR called me, completely horrified, and asked who I reported to. I said I was not sure. She was quiet for a long time. Then she offered me the job.
